duties.goal: The 5180 demo answers every time the owner opens it: /health within 10 s and /configure within 3 s, no SSR timeouts, no more than one dev-guard memory restart a day, its dev tree under 3000 MB, and 0 outside requests on the offline walk of the Staging pages. Tell the owner only when 5180 stays down for over an hour.

metrics.label: dev-guard memory restarts of 5180 over 24 h
SSR timeouts ("transport invoke timed out" errors) in the last 24 h
Memory of the 5180 dev tree now
Requests to a host other than localhost in the last offline walk
Sources this check could not read, or a stale or failed walk

duties.onMiss: Work in auto-sns-agent and read the flagged items. Down, slow or SSR timeouts: read the tail of .cache/pm2-dev/logs/virev-demo-error.log, restart virev-demo once with `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 restart virev-demo`, then GET /health again. Memory or guard restarts: carry on p86 (data in apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/12/1612-virev-demo-vite-memory/data/) and send the readings to ops guy. Walk missing, stale or failed: once /health answers, run the walk behind the load gate: in apps/virev-demo, `PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=$PWD/../../.cache/duties/virev-demo-offline.json ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright test tests/e2e/offline.spec.ts --reporter=json`. Outside requests: fix the leak in apps/virev-demo so the fake database answers. Fixes are one commit on the local sieun/dev tip under the VP of CI git rules. Never deploy to staging or prod, never move anything to 5174. Tell the owner only when 5180 is down over an hour. All on target: no message.

duties.goal: Each of the 6 Prospect apps on 5180 (Home, Inbox, Watchlist, Email, Creators, Connections) has an owner pick in the Staging line. An app with no pick never waits over 48 h for a new set to review, and the virev-demo unit and typecheck steps pass on sieun/dev. Each run tells the owner the 0 to 100% status of each tab.

duties.onMiss: Read the flagged items. Post one short chat line with a 0 to 100% status per tab, each with what done means and what is missing (c58). demo_ci_ok 0: fix the virev-demo test or type error first. For each no_pick app whose open steps show no live job, start one variant set job built against the canonical flows (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/10/1716-canonical-flows-storyboards), using the frontend design skill, about 70% building and 30% visual checks, no mobile or accessibility passes on mocks. When a set is built and checked in a desktop browser, put one For you todo for that app with links and screenshots inline. Never write picks into lines/staging.json; the owner picks with Put in line. Fixes are one commit on the local sieun/dev tip under the VP of CI git rules. Never deploy to staging or prod, never move anything to 5174 or the real app, and never ask the owner to (c40).
